name: Fundoshi Shoujo ~Hare~
source:
"The annual festival has begun. It's a melancholy time of year.
My father loves this festival too much, so every year I have to participate. I have to.
Even though someone as young as me shouldn't..."

[From [url=http://http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE142834.html]DLsite English[/url]]
